lead.headline: First place is a coin flip, and Lob City already has 68.96
lead.dek: Poochinski vs. Bad things man bad things: 169.56 to 170.22 at full strength, 49.4% to 50.6%. One team banked its points Thursday. The other is waiting on a Sunday-night stack.
lead.pull: Six-tenths of a point. That’s the projected gap for first place.
body: This is the game of the week, and it isn’t close to close. Poochinski is 6-1 with the most points in the league, 1,198.44. Bad things man bad things is 5-2 with the best all-play record in R.A.T.S., 32-17, one game better than Poochinski’s 31-18. One of these teams has the record. The other has been quietly arguing it deserves it.

Thursday night was a statement. Chuba Hubbard went for 24.9, Matthew Golden for 20.9, Tetairoa McMillan for 11.8 and Bryce Young for 11.36. That’s 68.96 in the bank before Poochinski has played a snap.

Poochinski doesn’t panic and doesn’t need to. Its answer is Jahmyr Gibbs and the Dak Prescott–CeeDee Lamb stack, the same stack that turned a 43-point deficit into a 58-point win last week. Put both rosters at full strength and the projection is 169.56 to 170.22. Six-tenths of a point for first place.

My pick is the team I cover, and I’m not apologizing for it. Bad things man bad things has the points banked and the deeper all-play résumé. But this is a 50.6% call, and last Monday proved that nobody in this league should trust a Thursday lead.

quick_hits.headline: Big Stric Energy is up 72.62 to nothing
quick_hits.body: Josh Jacobs (23.2), Jordan Love (22.52) and Tucker Kraft (17.3) did it again on Thursday night. Big Stric Energy is a 78.6% favorite to end the losing streak. It has also blown a 43.82-point lead in the last two weeks, so nobody is celebrating yet.

quick_hits.headline: Santa Clara’s Finest loses Lamar Jackson
quick_hits.body: Jackson is listed Out, and Santa Clara’s Finest starts two quarterbacks. Already down 72.62 to nothing, it’s a 21.4% shot to avoid a seventh loss.

quick_hits.headline: AB81 is a rare underdog
quick_hits.body: The champ leads 17.3 to nothing on Christian Watson’s Thursday night and projects for 159.43 to 138.1. AB81, 6-1 and luckier than anyone (+2.1 wins), is 30.6% to win.

quick_hits.headline: deeboliciouskins is the favorite in a race of two bye weeks
quick_hits.body: At full strength deeboliciouskins projects for 152.05 to Cherry Blossom’s 142.56, a 58.9% favorite. McCaffrey and Nabers are both off this week, so the depth charts decide it.

quick_hits.headline: Makai Lemon is the wire’s best receiver
quick_hits.body: Added 118,324 times on Sleeper in a day and projected for 9.6. Still available in R.A.T.S.

w8-m1.headline: Big lead, big history of blowing big leads
w8-m1.blurb: Big Stric Energy leads 72.62 to nothing and projects for 158.15 to 124.77. Santa Clara’s Finest needs a miracle without Lamar Jackson.

w8-m2.headline: First place, six-tenths of a point
w8-m2.blurb: Bad things man bad things has 68.96 banked. Poochinski has Gibbs and the Dallas stack still to come. 50.6% to 49.4%.

w8-m3.headline: Two teams better than their records
w8-m3.blurb: deeboliciouskins projects for 152.05, Cherry Blossom for 142.56. The second- and fourth-highest scoring teams in the league, with a playoff seed at stake.

w8-m4.headline: The champ is the favorite again
w8-m4.blurb: Maye I touch your TDs? leads 17.3 to nothing and projects for 159.43. AB81 projects for 138.1 and needs something its luck hasn’t provided yet: points.
